difficulty_reason: Computation of derived Hom out of a dg-injective target: uses the quasi-isomorphism N -> I to move to Hom(M, I), represents every morphism by an actual map using the second property of dg-injectives, and proves the injectivity of the resulting map by producing h with h g = id in the homotopy category, closing with the equality-of-morphisms criterion for left localisation. Retained author proof at lines 4522-4549.
